Cheap scan every queued candidate using exact vetted significance, event/quarter coverage, aliases, ownership, stellar/scene and literature evidence; rank evidence readiness and cost, not desired FPP.
Review PSF extraction/flattening and actual flux convention; no automatic CROWDSAP application, raw-SAP substitution or treating a PSF fit as SAP divided by target flux share.
Establish PSF/source-response and noise adequacy with source/extraction and known-object/end-to-end controls before NFPP/FPP interpretation.
Fit exact PSF_FLAT signals through standard transit-protected preparation, joint clock and native model; assess observed-photon detrending transfer.
Only admit scientifically reviewed PSF-based cases to fixed20-repeat/1M V3 probability policy.
